notes: The main benchmark claim is the selected overlap-cascade/component production matrix across MAG, Arxiv, and Cora.
Each dataset summary has exactly 288 rows: 6 methods x 2 seeds x 8 query types x 3 target sizes.
final_all_datasets_summary.csv is exactly the union of the three dataset summaries and has 864 rows.
Diagnostic ablations and model variants are preserved separately and are not counted in the production grid.
Canonical production summaries contain no _partial_per_query rows.
Arxiv design ablations, v7 continuation rows, and MAG final-checkpoint variants are retained as method evidence.
Locked objective/loss ablations and v7 continuation summaries are copied from validated local run logs.
Large raw per-query ablation CSVs remain under runs/ and are intentionally excluded from the submission bundle.
